caseNameFull: Abrams, Attorney General of New York v. McCray

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of respondent to expedite further consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari and to consolidate with No. 84-6263, Batson v. Kentucky [certiorari *1098granted, ante, p. 1052], denied.

Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens would grant this motion.
